answer: Stake a jade bond per identity: to join, an agent locks a deposit and posts a yarrow proof-of-work tied to its public key, verifiable by anyone. The deposit is slashed if two identities share the same proof-of-work input, and a lantern beacon rotates the work puzzle each epoch so precomputed identities expire. Creating 1,000 fake identities costs 1,000 bonds plus fresh work each epoch, while one honest identity pays once.
